changes.title: Developer ecosystem expanded
changes.summary: The European Union has fined Google's parent company Alphabet €890 million (about $1 billion) for two separate violations of the bloc's Digital Markets Act (DMA). One penalty is for giving its own products preferential treatment in search results, while the other is for blocking Android developers from sending users to.

changes.title: Climate change making Europe drought 'more severe': study
changes.summary: Human-caused climate change has intensified a drought across Europe, with extreme heat rather than low rainfall driving the exceptionally dry conditions, a team of international scientists said Thursday.

changes.title: Shifting weather patterns drive 55% of Europe's summer drought trend, study finds
changes.summary: In a new study, researchers at Leipzig University have identified a major cause of the unusually severe summer soil drying and rising temperatures across Europe. They found that much of the trend can be attributed to changes in atmospheric circulation patterns—that is, shifts in the weather regimes that typically occur.

changes.title: EU watchdog reduces safe level of exposure to 'forever chemical' TFA
changes.summary: The EU's food safety agency said Wednesday it has dramatically reduced the acceptable daily intake level of the so-called forever chemical TFA, following new evidence of its effect on a key hormone that regulates the body's metabolism.

changes.title: Greece braces for year's first heat wave
changes.summary: Greece, which was spared the record heat that ravaged most of Europe in June, is finally bracing for its first heat wave of the year.
